episodes.title: The History of Life on Earth
episodes.description: Trace the history of life while introducing ecology’s broad view of interactions among living things.

episodes.title: Population Ecology – The Texas Mosquito Mystery
episodes.description: Use a West Nile virus outbreak to explore population ecology and interactions within groups of a species.

episodes.title: Human Population Growth
episodes.description: Examine human population growth and the ecological consequences of our species’ success.

episodes.title: Community Ecology – Feel the Love
episodes.description: Interactions between species are what define ecological communities, and community ecology studies these interactions anywhere they take place.

episodes.title: Community Ecology II – Predators
episodes.description: Explore predation and the defensive adaptations prey use to avoid being eaten.

episodes.title: Ecological Succession – Change is Good
episodes.description: Today, Hank explains ecological succession and how ecological communities change over time to become beautiful, biodiverse mosaics.

episodes.title: Ecosystem Ecology – Links in the Chain
episodes.description: Follow energy, nutrients, and materials through ecosystems by examining feeding relationships.

episodes.title: The Hydrologic and Carbon Cycles – Always Recycle!
episodes.description: Hank introduces us to biogeochemical cycles by describing his two favorites: carbon and water.

episodes.title: Nitrogen & Phosphorus Cycles – Always Recycle! Part 2
episodes.description: Follow nitrogen and phosphorus through the cycles organisms depend on for essential nutrients.

episodes.title: 5 Human Impacts on the Environment
episodes.description: Examine five major human pressures on the environment and their effects on ecosystem services.

episodes.title: Pollution
episodes.description: Explore forms of pollution, from litter to endocrine disruptors, and their environmental effects.

episodes.title: Conservation and Restoration Ecology
episodes.description: Apply ecological principles to conservation and the restoration of damaged ecosystems.
